model: Power Xpert Meter 2000 - two DI / two DO card (virtual device)
applies_to: Eaton PXM 2000 meters fitted with the optional 2 digital input / 2 relay output card.
summary: The optional 2DI/2DO card shows up as its own virtual BACnet IP device. It gives the relay and input states, pulse accumulators (scaled and raw), the eight hardware limit set-ups that can drive the relays, accumulator divisors and labels.
notes: From IB150011EN Table 2 (two DI - two DO card). The card device object is not repeated in the points list; the doc prints no instance for it.
Object names carry the card path prefix /01/01/ as printed.
The booklet gives no units or access columns; all objects are listed as read-only.

source.title: BACnet object list for Power Xpert Meter 2000

integration.summary: Discover the card virtual device alongside the meter data device over BACnet IP and read its I/O states and counters.
setup: Each option card appears as a separate virtual BACnet device next to the meter data device.
gotchas: Object instances repeat across the meter and card devices; map them per device.
